metric_definition: Median wall-clock seconds of 3 timed runs per aggregation method; intermediate records passed to the final reduce
title: Aggregation methods A vs B
text: Method A (one global GROUP BY over all clean trips, DuckDB): median 0.11 s over 3 runs, 10,614,869 intermediate records. Method B (per-batch local counts = map + combiner, concatenated = shuffle, summed = reduce; pandas): median 0.47 s, 266,161 intermediate records. Both give identical results on 264,748 zone-hour keys. Hardware: Apple M1; 8 cores; 16 GB RAM; Darwin 23.4.0. A single-machine experiment, not a cluster benchmark.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Derived fields: zone-hour target
text: zone_id (integer; unit: TLC Taxi Zone ID): = PULocationID of retained trips. hour (timestamp; unit: New York local time): Pickup time rounded down to the hour (YYYY-MM-DD HH:00:00). pickup_count (integer; unit: trips per zone-hour): Number of retained trips that started in the zone in that hour. Recorded pickups only - not demand; 0 means no recorded pickup. coverage_ok (boolean; unit: flag): True when all months were acquired and the hour has at least one city-wide trip; only then is a missing count filled with 0.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Distance field and unit
text: trip_distance (float; unit: miles): Elapsed trip distance in miles reported by the taximeter.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Location fields and zones
text: PULocationID (integer; unit: TLC Taxi Zone ID): TLC Taxi Zone in which the taximeter was engaged; joins to LocationID in the Taxi Zone Lookup (265 rows; 264 = Unknown and 265 = Outside of NYC are excluded). DOLocationID (integer; unit: TLC Taxi Zone ID): TLC Taxi Zone in which the taximeter was disengaged.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Fare and payment amounts (US dollars)
text: fare_amount (float; unit: US dollars): Time-and-distance fare calculated by the meter. tip_amount (float; unit: US dollars): Tip amount; populated for credit card tips; cash tips are not included. total_amount (float; unit: US dollars): Total amount charged to passengers; does not include cash tips. Airport_fee (float; unit: US dollars): Airport fee charged for pickups at LaGuardia and JFK airports.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Time fields and time zone
text: tpep_pickup_datetime (timestamp; unit: New York local time): Date and time when the meter was engaged. Interpreted as New York local time (no daylight-saving change between April and June 2024). tpep_dropoff_datetime (timestamp; unit: New York local time): Date and time when the meter was disengaged.

metric_definition: TLC data dictionary fields and project-derived fields; units as stated per field
title: Data dictionary - Trip attributes and codes
text: passenger_count (integer; unit: passengers): Number of passengers in the vehicle (entered by the driver). RatecodeID (integer; unit: code): Final rate code at the end of the trip: 1 Standard; 2 JFK; 3 Newark; 4 Nassau or Westchester; 5 Negotiated fare; 6 Group ride; 99 Null/unknown. payment_type (integer; unit: code): How the passenger paid: 1 Credit card; 2 Cash; 3 No charge; 4 Dispute; 5 Unknown; 6 Voided trip. Code 0 appears in 2024 files with missing fields and is not in the dictionary.

metric_definition: Forecast specification frozen before the June test
title: Forecast setup
text: Target: pickups in hour h=t+1 per zone, predicted at the end of hour t. Features: zone_id, hour_of_day, weekday, lag1, lag24, mean24, lag168 (lag1=y(t), lag24=y(h-24), mean24=mean of the last 24 observed hours, lag168=y(h-168)); all use hours up to t only. Baseline: same zone and hour 7 days earlier. Model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor; settings compared on May: hgb_a May MAE 20.48; hgb_b May MAE 20.57; hgb_c May MAE 20.43; hgb_d May MAE 20.21; May baseline MAE 28.84. Chosen: hgb_d (lowest May MAE), refit once on April+May, tested on June without refitting. Rows lacking 168 h history dropped: 3,360.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R1
text: Rule R1. Condition: pickup or dropoff timestamp is NULL (Parquet stores typed timestamps, so 'unparseable' = NULL). Action: quarantine. Reason: No valid pickup hour, so the trip cannot be counted. Counts: input rows 10,777,315; retained rows 10,777,315; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 0.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R2
text: Rule R2. Condition: pickup outside [2024-04-01 00:00, 2024-07-01 00:00) New York local time. Action: quarantine. Reason: Out of scope (e.g. 2002/2009/2026 dates). Scope is set by pickup time, not by source file. Counts: input rows 10,777,315; retained rows 10,777,291; quarantined rows 24; flagged rows 0.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R3
text: Rule R3. Condition: PULocationID not in zone lookup, or 264 (Unknown) / 265 (Outside of NYC). Action: quarantine. Reason: Pickup cannot be assigned to a real NYC zone. Counts: input rows 10,777,291; retained rows 10,737,066; quarantined rows 40,225; flagged rows 0.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R4
text: Rule R4. Condition: all 19 source columns identical to an earlier row; first copy kept. Action: quarantine extra copies. Reason: Same vendor, second-level timestamps, zones, distance and every fare component: a double submission, not two real trips. Counts: input rows 10,737,066; retained rows 10,737,066; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 0.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R4b
text: Rule R4b. Condition: total_amount < 0 and an unmatched row with the same vendor, pickup, dropoff, PU and DO has total_amount = -this total (matched one-to-one). Action: quarantine the negative reversal; keep the original. Reason: TLC records a void/dispute as the original plus a negative reversal with identical timestamps: one pickup, two accounting rows. Counting both double-counts the pickup. Counts: input rows 10,737,066; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 122,197; flagged rows 0.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R5
text: Rule R5. Condition: dropoff <= pickup, or duration > 24 h. Action: flag f_order (retained). Reason: Pickup hour is still valid; only the duration is unreliable. Counts: input rows 10,614,869; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 3,126.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R6a
text: Rule R6a. Condition: trip_distance <= 0 or > 100 mi. Action: flag f_distance (retained). Reason: Kept in pickup counts; excluded only from distance analyses. Counts: input rows 10,614,869; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 132,180.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R6b
text: Rule R6b. Condition: fare_amount < 0 or > 1000, or total_amount < 0. Action: flag f_fare (retained). Reason: Kept in pickup counts; excluded only from fare analyses (negatives are refunds/voids). Counts: input rows 10,614,869; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 56,986.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule R7
text: Rule R7. Condition: NULL passenger_count, RatecodeID, store_and_fwd_flag, congestion_surcharge or Airport_fee. Action: flag f_missing (retained, not filled). Reason: Not filled with 0; kept NULL because the pickup itself is valid. Counts: input rows 10,614,869; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 0; flagged rows 1,222,683.

metric_definition: Trip-row counts before/after one cleaning rule over all 3 monthly files (April-June 2024); quarantined rows are removed from pickup counts, flagged rows are kept
title: Quality rule TOTAL
text: Rule TOTAL. Condition: all rules; a row is quarantined by its first failing rule only. Action: retained + quarantined = input. Reason: flags never remove rows; flagged_rows counts rows with at least one flag. Counts: input rows 10,777,315; retained rows 10,614,869; quarantined rows 162,446; flagged rows 1,349,763.

metric_definition: Project configuration: scope, target, zone selection and split
title: Scope, target and split
text: Data: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips for months 2024-04, 2024-05, 2024-06, pickup window [2024-04-01 00:00:00, 2024-07-01 00:00:00) New York local time. Target: pickup_count per zone and hour (recorded pickups, not demand). Forecast zones: top 20 zones by retained pickups in 2024-04, ties to lower zone_id, fixed for the project. Temporal split: train 2024-04, validation 2024-05, test 2024-06. Random seed 42. Zones 264 (Unknown) and 265 (Outside of NYC) excluded.
